recs.stt: Cat jumps from fifth floor of burning building, bounces and strolls away (2021)
recs.x:
> the exact mechanics of the animal’s righting reflex are still not completely understood.

I don't think this is true anymore. They move their head and tail to rotate themselves upright, and due to their low weight their terminal velocity is not fatal. This video has a good explanation of the process, [link] 
Squirrels use a similar technique, Mark Rober has made some good videos explaining that.
